messages:
maya: Quick brainstorm — launch plan for a performance->cost narrative. Thinking 3 core outputs: a short launch post, a two-slide 'throughput vs $' visual, and a webinar to walk platform teams through tradeoffs. Who can help map audiences and routing?

sam: Nice. Audience slices: 1) Product/ML engineers (PLG/demo), 2) Platform/Infra (ops/throughput buyers), 3) Procurement/Security (enterprise, SLA-focused). Routing idea: enterprise signals -> AE queue, infra leads -> SDR + webinar invite, product/dev -> self-serve nurture.

jordan: For visuals I want two simple charts: A) tokens-per-dollar vs median p95 latency (curve + callouts), B) throughput-per-GPU vs unit-cost heatmap (rows by model family). Keep them extremely skimmable — 1 headline claim each.

lia: Email plan = 3 sequences: technical short (1 email + code sample), business short (value props + $s saved), nurture (4-touch with webinar invite mid-cycle). Draft subjects: "Speed that scales, cost that shrinks", "When latency costs more than cloud", "See tradeoffs live: webinar".

eli: Draft HubSpot routing logic (sketch):
```
if company_size >= 500 AND intent_score > 70 -> assign = "AE:enterprise"
elif page_viewed in ["/pricing","/dedicated"] OR utm_campaign=="perf-cost" -> workflow = "priority-webinar"
else -> workflow = "dev-drip-3"
```
(we'll add region and compliance flags).

hubspot-bot: Workflow created: perf-cost-launch-2026 (id: wf_2026_07).

sam: Social/content: 2 dev-focused posts (code snippet + perf numbers) and 2 platform posts (SLA + dollar delta). CTAs: Try API, Watch webinar, Request dedicated demo. Keep one short carousel for LinkedIn with the two charts.

maya: Webinar runbook: 30m talk (product + infra tradeoffs), 20m live Q, 10m panel with a customer who moved from self-serve to dedicated. Demos: 1) low-latency config with caching, 2) fallback to cheaper quantized model for cost spikes. Need tech checklist for demo reliability.

jordan: Suggest an AB test on headline claim + visual framing: Variant A = "tokens → $" (direct econ), Variant B = "latency → ops dollars" (ops framing). Track CTR -> demo signups over 2 weeks. Output CSV for analytics team: columns = variant, impressions, CTR, demo_signups.

lia: I'll own email sequence drafts (deadline: Fri EOD). @sam can you make the two slides? @jordan please provide the data table for both charts and the AB testing plan. @eli will wire HubSpot rules and confirm AE queue mapping.

sam: Yup — slides first pass by Thu EOD. Will include alt text and plain PNGs for email.

maya: Great — action items noted. I'll draft the launch post tonight and drop in the doc for inline edits. Quick wins: share a 1-paragraph TL;DR we can use as social copy and a 2-line subject for the webinar invite. :rocket:

eli: FYI added a tracking tag: utm_source=perf_cost_launch to the webinar link.

jordan: I'll also include a tiny table for the blog showing a sample call: 
```
Model,Latency(ms),Tokens/$
redwood-8k,80,120k
quantized-4bit,110,180k
```

maya: Awesome — good cadence. Follow-ups in the doc. Thanks all. :pray:
